svg.title: Four gaps found by reading the code, each with a fix. A restart mid-run leaves the row saying running, and resume refuses it: on startup, mark leftover running rows as interrupted and allow resuming them. "Paused" really means pause requested, so resuming in that gap can start two copies: separate pause requested from paused. Resume only blocks running runs, so it would restart finished or waiting runs: list the statuses resume accepts. Clients have to keep polling even when a run waits for days: notify them with a webhook, which the course does not build.
